id: title:amays-phog:project billing routes over the organization reads

review.posthog_relevance: Adds billing-specific API routes, scopes, and export mechanisms for project-level billing read and CSV exports, supporting billing dashboards and customer-facing billing reports.
review.reason: The change introduces a complete billing API capability including route registration, permission scopes, and backend implementation for usage/spend timeseries and exports. While P1.F14.H3 lacks backend implementation, P1.F1, P1.F2, P1.F3, P1.F6, P1.F7, and P1.F11 provide the necessary backend, permission, and test support. P1.F1.H4, P1.F1.H6, and P1.F1.H7 show compatibility issues,
review.uncertainty: P1.F14.H3 lacks backend implementation and tests, and P1.F1 compatibility issues remain unverified; tier assigned based on the presence of backend implementation and permission setup in other hunks.
